Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied Spanish naming conventions by claiming the first surname is maternal (it is paternal), which led to swapping maternal and paternal lines and ignoring the cited source stating Queen Sofía is the maternal grandmother; thus incorrectly concluding Concepción Sáenz de Tejada (the paternal grandmother) as the maternal grandmother.
